details.description: Sensitive API keys and authentication tokens are hardcoded in the source code, making them easily accessible to anyone with access to the code.
details.fix_explanation: Replaced hardcoded values with environment variables to prevent exposure in version control and allow secure configuration.
details.secure_code_snippet:
PAYMENT_TOKEN = os.environ.get("PAYMENT_TOKEN", "")
MAIL_SERVER_KEY = os.environ.get("MAIL_SERVER_KEY", "")
INTERNAL_AUTH = os.environ.get("INTERNAL_AUTH", "")

details.description: User input is directly concatenated into SQL query string, allowing potential injection attacks.
details.fix_explanation: Used parameterized queries with placeholders to safely bind user input, preventing SQL injection.
details.secure_code_snippet: c.execute("SELECT id,name,balance FROM profiles WHERE id = ?", (uid,))

details.description: User input is used in shell command execution, allowing arbitrary command execution.
details.fix_explanation: Replaced shell=True with subprocess.run using a list of arguments and added input validation to sanitize the name parameter.

details.description: MD5 hash is used for authentication, which is cryptographically weak and susceptible to collisions.
details.fix_explanation: Replaced MD5 with SHA-256 for stronger hashing security.

details.description: User-provided file path is used without validation, allowing access to arbitrary files.
details.fix_explanation: Added validation to ensure the path is safe, restricting to .yaml files and preventing directory traversal.
details.secure_code_snippet:
if not path or not isinstance(path, str) or ".." in path or not path.endswith(".yaml"):
    raise ValueError("Invalid path")

details.description: User-provided URL is used in HTTP requests without validation, potentially allowing internal network access.
details.fix_explanation: Added validation to ensure URLs start with https:// and are properly formatted.
details.secure_code_snippet:
if not notify_url or not isinstance(notify_url, str) or not notify_url.startswith("https://"):
    raise ValueError("Invalid notify_url")

details.description: User inputs are not validated, leading to potential type errors or unexpected behavior.
details.fix_explanation: Added comprehensive input validation in all functions to check types, lengths, and formats.
details.secure_code_snippet:
if not username or not isinstance(username, str) or len(username) > 50:
    raise ValueError("Invalid username")

details.description: Flask app runs in debug mode, which can expose sensitive information in production.
details.fix_explanation: Removed debug=True to prevent information leakage in production environments.
